Enbridge Inc Buy Tallgrass Crude Unit
: Enbridge (ENB) will buy Tallgrass’s crude unit for $2.55B, gaining 75% of Pony Express (~460,000 bpd), 51% of Powder River (~240,000 bpd), 8.4M barrels storage; closes in 2026 pending approvals.
: Enbridge (ENB) CEO Greg Ebel will retire Dec 31, 2026. Michele Harradence will succeed him as CEO and join the board Jan 1, 2027. Ebel to advise through May 2027.
: Enbridge (ENB) launched a bought‑deal share sale to raise ~CDN$2.6B via 38.9M shares at CDN$66.85; underwriter option could lift proceeds to ~CDN$3.0B; expected close ~Sept 14, 2026.
